title: Spectator attach can freeze a live game during watch/init
description:
The `bolt_on_stack` golden failure in GitHub Actions run 22931624842 correlates tightly with the spectator auto-watch path. The failed game (`5aef1128-f71e-4875-85bf-6e2b01a60286`) stalls immediately after TestPlayer receives a `GAME_SELECT` in T1 postcombat main, then the spectator starts watching ~0.9s later and requests hand permissions from both players. After that, both bridges wait forever for the next callback.

The reverted `GameController.perform()` reorder does not match the evidence well: the server log never showed the `waitResponseOpen` timeout warning that theory predicts. A more plausible root cause is the existing TODO in `GameSessionWatcher.init()`: spectator watch calls `getGameView()` / `game.copy()` off the game thread while the game is live. That path races with live game mutation and may also interact badly with the concurrent hand-permission requests triggered by observer startup.

Instrumentation has been added around watcher attach, non-game-thread `getGameView()`, ignored player responses, and delayed `waitResponseOpen()` calls so the next recurrence will show whether the stall is in the observer attach/copy path or the response handoff path.
